# Agent Accelerator

> Thin, typed TypeScript SDK (Bun, ships TypeScript source): one `Agent` class over Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Tools, streaming, sub-agents, scheduled actions, mid-session steer/queue/interrupt, durable sessions, structured output, multimodal input, prompt caching, budgets/retries, telemetry bus, safe file/URL handling. Pre-1.0: pin a version. Import everything from "agent-accelerator". Paths are relative to docs/.

- [For AI agents](for-ai-agents.md): decision table, templates, hard rules, what does NOT exist, error-to-fix lookup
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): install, keys, first agent, concepts
- [Agents and models](guides/agents-and-models.md): Agent, run/ask/stream, sessions in memory, model routing, providers, thinking, caching, structured output, self-improving agents (`toConfig`/`fromConfig`), the program's model list (`setModels`)
- [Tools and streaming](guides/tools-and-streaming.md): tool(), execution rules, toolChoice, streaming, events, steer/queue/interrupt
- [Multi-agent and scheduling](guides/multi-agent.md): fixed and dynamic sub-agents, tracking, scheduled actions (DD:HH:MM)
- [Data and media](guides/data-and-media.md): persistence/resume, images/audio/video/files, usage and cost, model catalog
- [Generating images](guides/images.md): `generateImage`, the supported image models (`listImageModels`), options checked per model, results, `image.edit`, `imageTool`, errors
- [Generating videos](guides/videos.md): `generateVideo`, the known video models (`listVideoModels`: Google `gemini-omni-1.2-flash` and OpenRouter's cached list), options checked per model (length, tier, ratio, frames, reference pictures and clips with MP4 length limits), polling and `onProgress`, `jobId` on timeouts, `video.edit` (Google interaction / OpenRouter `previous_job_id`), `resumeVideo`, `VideoResult`, errors
- [Testing your agents](guides/testing.md): `fauxProvider(steps)` (scripted model: text, thinking, tool calls, usage, cost, errors, delays, function steps), `faux.config` / `calls` / `remaining` / `push` / `reset`, runs through the real adapter, streaming works
- [Asking decision models](guides/decisions.md): `generateDecision`, typed yes/no (`noul`), `choice` and `score` questions in the providers' own shapes, probabilities and `confidence`, the known decision models (`listDecisionModels`), checks per model, OpenRouter's cached model list, errors
- [Generating embeddings](guides/embeddings.md): `generateEmbedding`, the known embedding models (`listEmbeddingModels`), one `task` option for every model, options checked per model, `cosineSimilarity`, OpenRouter's cached model list, errors
- [Safety and operations](guides/safety-and-ops.md): limits, budget, retry, onFailure, errors, telemetry, security, known limitations
- [Prompts](guides/prompts.md): the SDK's own prompts, `DEFAULT_PROMPTS`, `AgentConfig.prompts`, placeholders
- [Scheduled action files](scheduled-action-files.md): stable on-disk format of scheduled actions (task.json, delivery.json, run file header), reading, editing rules, changelog
- [Reference](reference.md): all AgentConfig keys, run options, response fields, stream events, telemetry codes, errors, env vars
